title: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analysis reveals 4-HNE-related stromal remodeling in lung adenocarcinoma.
snippet: 4-HNE is a lipid peroxidation product involved in oxidative stress, tumor microenvironment remodeling, and tumor progression. This study aimed to characterize the cellular distribution, prognostic relevance, and functional roles of 4-HNE-related molecular features in lung adenocarcinoma. 4-HNE-related targets were collected from ChEMBL and SwissTargetPredic...
